description: This file defines the BackupService class for handling backup and restore operations of notes in an Android app, including notification management and coroutine job handling.

classes.name: BackupService
classes.description: A lifecycle-aware Android service that manages backup and restore of notes, including notification updates and coroutine job management.

classes.name: BackupService.Action
classes.description: Enum representing backup or restore actions.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Handles incoming intents to trigger backup or restore operations.

methods.name: onTimeout
methods.description: Cancels all jobs and stops the service on timeout.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cancels the lifecycle scope when service is destroyed.

methods.name: startJob
methods.description: Launches a coroutine job and manages its completion.

methods.name: backupNotes
methods.description: Performs backup of notes, showing notifications for progress, success, or failure.

methods.name: restoreNotes
methods.description: Performs restore of notes from a URI, with notification updates.
